again.harder: More like this, a bit harder
again.harder_topic: More like this, a bit harder: {{topics}}

bar.shade_how: Tap the parts of the bar.
bar.pick_how: Tap the bar that is more.

cards.note: Flashcards – you say yourself whether you knew it.
cards.turn_hint: Shows the answer. Then you say yourself whether you knew it.
cards.knew_hint: Notes that you had it. The word will come round again later.
cards.not_yet_hint: Notes that you need it again. The word will come back soon.
cards.end_hint: Back to Buddy. The cards you have done stay done.
cards.done_body: You went through your words. The ones that were not there yet will come back.
cards.offer: Go through the words as cards
cards.offer_hint: Shows you the words that were not there yet, one by one – turn each over for the answer.

dispute.done: All right – that one does not count.
dispute.hint: Takes this question and its mark back.
dispute.sheet_body: Then I take this question out — it does not count and will not come up again. Your progress stays as it was before.

end_hint: Back to Buddy. Your answers are saved – you can carry on here later.
end_hint_test: Hands in the practice test and shows you how it went.
finish_failed: I couldn't load your result just now.
finishing: One moment – your result is on its way.
more_coming: The next questions are on their way …

flag.hint: Takes this question out; it won't come up again.
flag.sheet_body: This question won't come up again.
flag.done: Got it – the question is out.

help_note: Homework – I'll give you hints, you'll find the answer yourself.
later_done: All right – that one comes back later.
later_hint: The task stays open and comes back after the others.

listen.hint: Plays the text for you – as often as you like.
listen.failed: The text cannot be played right now.

match.how_pairs: Tap one on the left, then its partner on the right.
match.how_groups: Tap one at the top, then its group.
match.hint_group_waits: Tap something at the top first.

order.hint_placed: Takes it back – and everything after it.
order.check_waits: Once every one has a place.

reexplain.label: Explain it differently?
reexplain.hint: Buddy explains it again, this way.
reexplain.thinking: Buddy is explaining it another way …
reexplain.title: Explained another way

self_solved.title: Solved it yourself!
self_solved.body: You worked that out on your own.

solution.title: Solution
solution.calm: Take your time to look at it.

speak.no_voice: Reading aloud isn't working on this device right now – the voice for this language may be missing.
speak.record_stop_label: Stop recording and send it to Buddy
speak.record_hint: Tap, say the sentence, then tap Done. Thirty seconds at most.
speak.waiting_offline: No connection right now. Your recording will be sent as soon as you're back online.
speak.send_failed: Your recording hasn't reached Buddy yet.
speak.denied: Without the microphone I can't hear you. You can allow it in Settings.
speak.denied_web: Without the microphone I can't hear you. Allow it at the top of your browser, then tap Speak again.

problem.too_short: That was very short. Tap Speak, say the whole sentence, then tap Done.
problem.unsupported: I can't read this recording, sorry. Please try again.
problem.failed: The recording didn't work. Please try again.

speak.word_hint: Just this word – it does not count towards the question.
speak.word_again: Almost – listen again and try it.

staff.no_sound: No sound is coming out here right now.
staff.bar_crowded: There is no room for another symbol in bar {{n}}.

summary_line.all_first: All of it right the first time.

test_note: Practice test – one answer per question, no hints. You'll see the result at the end.

thread.thinking: Buddy is looking at your answer …

table.check_waits: Only once every cell is filled in.

mark.how_gaps: Tap between the words where a comma belongs.
mark.how_syllables: Tap the letter after which a syllable ends.

reading.label: Reading text
reading.show_hint: Shows the text with line numbers.
reading.hide_hint: Collapses the text; the question stays.
reading.scroll_hint: The text scrolls on its own.
